scope.inclusion: All session metadata records under the current root session whose canonical path starts /root/architecture_, including descendants at every depth.
exclusions: Archived earlier architecture task; listed separately

definitions.uniqueAgent: Distinct session metadata threadId. Followup reuse never increases this count.
definitions.participant: Agent creation or observed assistant response/function-call metadata inside the phase window. Send-message receipt alone does not establish participation.
definitions.followupInvocations: Distinct observed followup_task call IDs; not a claim that each call starts a new execution turn.
definitions.role: One exclusive primary role per agent; reviewer helpers are included in evaluator count but are not additional independent final report authors.
definitions.rounds: R1 and R2 are explicit review rounds. Multiple corrections/followups before R2 sealing remain R2 subiterations; no invented R3.
definitions.concurrency: Peak simultaneous active agents is not reported because a complete scheduler lifecycle trace was not audited.

roundBoundary.method: First BEGIN R2 followup to four lead reviewers; timestamps and target names read from tool metadata, task meaning confirmed by root coordinator. Message bodies are encrypted and were neither decrypted nor pattern-classified.

provenance.sourceKind: Local Codex session first-line metadata and selected response_item tool invocation metadata
reproduce: Enumerate local session JSONL files; parse only first-line session_meta identity/parent/path/timestamp fields.
Filter exact main root session ID and /root/architecture_ path prefix; deduplicate threadId.

For included agents and root, parse response_item metadata only. Select spawn_agent/followup_task/interrupt_agent name, call ID, target/task_name and timestamp. Do not copy or interpret message bodies.
Resolve relative targets against actor path, then root for recorded root-relative targets. Include only targets found in the selected agent registry.
Use the four root-confirmed first reviewer followups as the R2 boundary. Count creations and observed assistant activity within the two time windows.
Classify the exclusive primary ownership roles recorded in this artifact; aggregate without double counting.
